Patient seen in clinic for evaluation of elevated blood pressure readings
taken at home over the past month. She reports occasional headaches in the
mornings but denies chest pain, visual changes, or shortness of breath.

On examination, blood pressure is 152/94 mmHg, confirmed on repeat
measurement. Heart rate is 88 and regular. Weight 82.5kg, BMI 30.1.

Based on today's readings and the home log, she meets criteria for
essential hypertension. We discussed lifestyle modification including
sodium reduction and regular exercise. Start Lisinopril 10mg once daily
for hypertension. She will monitor blood pressure at home and return in
30 days for follow-up; basic metabolic panel to be drawn before that
visit to establish baseline renal function.
